content: Do I need to lift heavy to build muscle?

No, you don't have to. Studies show muscle growth is similar across a wide range of loads, from about 5 to 30 reps, as long as your sets end close to failure (around 0-3 reps left). Heavier loads aren't required for size, but they're more time-efficient, and they're the better tool for your goal.

💡 Your 100 kg bench goal is a strength goal, and strength is specific. To hit it, you'll need to practice heavy sets (roughly 1-6 reps) on the bench. Mix those with 8-12 rep work on your accessories for size.
